scripts.en: Using Claude-Code? Codex? Cline? Ollama? Maybe Playwright, Supabase, Context7, Azure, Figma… or WhatsApp MCP?... A thousand AI tools... And somehow - *YOU* - became the integration layer: Copying context. Pasting keys. Repeating yourself... Tired of micromanaging them all?

Meet FLUHO. One app, "local first", to connect the models you choose, the tools you trust, and the workflows that make them useful. First, define your Models: Use subscriptions, paid APIs, or local models. Store an API key once—encrypted—and never type it again.

Then design the job. Start with a prompt. Give each agent a role, the context it needs, and the right amount of tools—maybe two, not twenty... Branch. Loop. Hand the work to another agent. Or call an entire flow as one reusable step. *YOU* decide what every step can see—and what it can do.
Now turn those workflows into a team: research, build, test, review. Let an orchestrator choose who goes next, pass work between specialists, and loop until the result is ready.

And when the work shouldn’t wait for you, add a trigger: every morning, every twenty minutes, on a webhook, when a file or URL changes..., when a new message arrives, or when another flow finishes—or fails. FLUHO runs it headlessly and keeps the history.

You prefer to stay in the loop? Open Chat and choose the same flow. Watch every handoff and tool call live. Check token use. Pause at a breakpoint. Inspect the state. Require approval before a tool acts.

And FLUHO doesn’t trap your setup. Reuse its MCP servers from Claude Desktop, Cline, Cursor, or other clients. Or expose any flow through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint—and call a whole team like a model.
Your models. Your tools. Your keys. Your rules. Stop managing AI one prompt at a time. Put your AI in flow. With FLUHO
